color-fg.$description: Primary body text color on light backgrounds. Near-black for trustworthy, high-contrast reading.

color-fg-muted.$description: Secondary text: captions, helper text, timestamps.

color-bg.$description: Default page background. Warm off-white, like a pizzeria tablecloth, not clinical white.

color-surface.$description: Elevated surface background for cards and panels sitting on color-bg.

color-primary.$description: Brand action color: baked-crust red, used for primary CTAs like Add to Order / Checkout.

color-primary-hover.$description: Hover/pressed state for primary actions, slightly deeper red.

color-primary-fg.$description: Text/icon color on top of color-primary fills.

color-accent.$description: Secondary brand accent: basil green, used sparingly for success/fresh-ingredient cues.

color-border.$description: Default border color for cards, inputs and dividers.

color-danger.$description: Error/destructive state color, e.g. failed payment, remove item.

space-1.$description: Tightest spacing: icon-to-label gaps, chip padding.

space-2.$description: Compact spacing: form control padding, tight stacks.

space-3.$description: Standard spacing: card padding, gaps between related elements.

space-4.$description: Generous spacing: section gaps, page gutters, giving a spacious, unhurried consumer feel.

radius-sm.$description: Subtle rounding for chips and small controls.

radius-md.$description: Standard rounding for buttons and inputs, friendly but not playful.

radius-lg.$description: Card and modal rounding, soft enough to feel warm and trustworthy.

font-family-base.$description: Primary typeface for all UI text: a humanist sans for a clean, trustworthy read.

font-family-display.$description: Headline typeface for hero/menu titles, adds warmth without sacrificing legibility.

font-size-md.$description: Default body text and form controls.

font-size-lg.$description: Section headings and menu item names.

shadow-card.$description: Soft elevation for cards resting on the page background.

button-primary-background.$description: Primary button fill, e.g. Add to Order, Place Order.

button-secondary-background.$description: Secondary button fill, e.g. Customize, Cancel.

button-radius.$description: Corner radius shared by all button variants.

card-default-background.$description: Card surface fill, e.g. menu item cards, order summary card.
